name: Christopher Ward
verdict: The watch brand of Christopher Ward London Limited, owned 75%+ by Christopher Ward (London) Holdings Limited, whose only listed significant controller is investor BGF GP Limited. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Official Global Timing Partner of Everton since 2022 and, from 2026/27, the club's first Official Training Kit Partner (branding on the men's and women's first-team training wear, per Prolific North, 9 July 2026). The Companies House PSC register shows the holding company's only active significant controller as BGF GP Limited (25-50% of voting rights); co-founder Mike France is CEO per the club announcement coverage. No state or state-fund link found.
